verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑הס וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י׀ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֗יו וְאֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·lam kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh lə·ḇêṯ yə·h·wå̄·hs way·yā·ḇê šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- kāl- hak·kê·lîm nā·ṯan bə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So all the work that Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated the silver the gold and all the furnishings and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of God
verses.literalPt: Assim, se acabou toda a obra que Salomão fez para a Casa de Jeová. Salomão trouxe as coisas que seu pai Davi tinha dedicado, a saber: a prata, o ouro e todos os vasos, e pô-los nos tesouros da Casa de Deus.

verses.original: אָז֩ יַקְהֵ֨יל שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַמַּטּ֜וֹת נְשִׂיאֵ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־ אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yaq·hêl šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- kāl- rā·šê ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ nə·śî·’ê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh mê·‘îr dā·wîḏ hî ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: At that time Solomon assembled in Jerusalem the elders of Israel all the tribal heads and family leaders . . . of the Israelites to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD - from Zion the City of David
verses.literalPt: Então, congregou Salomão em Jerusalém os anciãos de Israel, todos os cabeças das tribos, príncipes das famílias dos filhos de Israel, para fazerem subir a arca da Aliança de Jeová da Cidade de Davi, que é Sião.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּהֲל֧וּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּחָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·hă·lū ’el- ham·me·leḵ kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl be·ḥāḡ hū ha·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇi·‘î
verses.literal: So all the men of Israel came together to the king at the feast in the seventh month
verses.literalPt: Todos os homens se congregaram ao rei na festa, que era no sétimo mês.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kōl ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiś·’ū hal·wî·yim ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rō·wn
verses.literal: When all the elders of Israel had arrived the Levites took up the ark
verses.literalPt: Todos os anciãos de Israel vieram, e os levitas levantaram a arca.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ אֶת־ הָאָרוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֑הֶל הֶעֱל֣וּ אֹתָ֔ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer bā·’ō·hel he·‘ĕ·lū ’ō·ṯām hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings The Levitical priests carried them up
verses.literalPt: Levaram a arca, a tenda da revelação e todos os vasos sagrados que estavam na Tenda; levaram-nos os levitas sacerdotes.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְכָל־ עֲדַ֧ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַנּוֹעָדִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֑וֹן מְזַבְּחִים֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְלֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl han·nō·w·‘ā·ḏîm ‘ā·lāw lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār ’ă·šer lō- yis·sā·p̄ə·rū wə·lō yim·mā·nū mê·rōḇ
verses.literal: There, before the ark King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted . . . or numbered
verses.literalPt: O rei e toda a congregação, que fora convocada a ele, estavam diante da arca, sacrificando ovelhas e bois, que não se podiam contar, nem numerar por causa da sua multidão.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ הַ֠כֹּהֲנִים אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ מְקוֹמ֛וֹ אֶל־ דְּבִ֥יר הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־ תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’el- mə·qō·w·mōw ’el- də·ḇîr hab·ba·yiṯ ’el- qō·ḏeš haq·qə·ḏā·šîm ’el- ta·ḥaṯ kan·p̄ê hak·kə·rū·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple the Most Holy Place . . . . . . beneath the wings of the cherubim
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram os sacerdotes a arca da Aliança de Jeová ao seu lugar, no oráculo da casa, o Santo dos Santos, para debaixo das asas dos querubins.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ הַכְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם עַל־ מְק֖וֹם הָאָר֑וֹן וַיְכַסּ֧וּ הַכְּרוּבִ֛ים עַל־ הָאָר֥וֹן וְעַל־ בַּדָּ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū hak·kə·rū·ḇîm pō·rə·śîm kə·nā·p̄a·yim ‘al- mə·qō·wm hā·’ā·rō·wn way·ḵas·sū hak·kə·rū·ḇîm ‘al- hā·’ā·rō·wn wə·‘al- bad·dāw mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed . . . the ark and its poles
verses.literalPt: Porque os querubins estendiam as suas asas sobre o lugar em que estava posta a arca, e os querubins por cima cobriam a arca e os seus varais.

verses.original: וַֽיַּאֲרִיכוּ֮ הַבַּדִּים֒ וַיֵּרָאוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַבַּדִּ֤ים מִן־ הָאָרוֹן֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וְלֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַח֑וּצָה וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·’ă·rî·ḵū hab·bad·dîm way·yê·rā·’ū rā·šê hab·bad·dîm min- hā·’ā·rō·wn ‘al- pə·nê had·də·ḇîr wə·lō yê·rā·’ū ha·ḥū·ṣāh way·hî- šām ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: The poles of the ark extended far enough that their ends were visible from in front of the inner sanctuary but not from outside the Holy Place and they are there to this day
verses.literalPt: Os varais eram tão compridos, que as suas extremidades se viam da arca diante do oráculo; porém não se viam do lado de fora. Ali, está a arca até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽאָר֔וֹן רַ֚ק שְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּחֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִם־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ên bā·’ā·rō·wn raq šə·nê hal·lu·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan mō·šeh bə·ḥō·rêḇ ’ă·šer kā·raṯ Yah·weh ‘im- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṣê·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites . . . after they had come out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Não havia na arca coisa alguma senão as duas tábuas que Moisés ali pôs em Horebe, quando Jeová fez uma aliança com os filhos de Israel, ao saírem eles do Egito.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י בְּצֵ֥את הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים מִן־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֠י כָּל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֙ הִתְקַדָּ֔שׁוּ אֵ֖ין לִשְׁמ֥וֹר לְמַחְלְקֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ṣêṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm min- haq·qō·ḏeš kî kāl- hak·kō·hă·nîm han·nim·ṣə·’îm hiṯ·qad·dā·šū ’ên liš·mō·wr lə·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves regardless of . . . their divisions And when the priests came out of the Holy Place
verses.literalPt: Tendo os sacerdotes saído do Santo Lugar (porque todos os sacerdotes que estavam presentes se tinham santificado, sem observarem as ordens das suas turmas;

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַמְשֹׁרֲרִ֣ים לְכֻלָּ֡ם לְאָסָ֡ף לְהֵימָ֣ן לִֽ֠ידֻתוּן וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֨ם וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם מְלֻבָּשִׁ֣ים בּ֗וּץ בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים מִזְרָ֣ח לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעִמָּהֶ֤ם כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְמֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים מַחְצְרִרִים בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·wî·yim ham·šō·ră·rîm lə·ḵul·lām lə·’ā·sāp̄ lə·hê·mān lî·ḏu·ṯūn wə·liḇ·nê·hem wə·la·’ă·ḥê·hem mə·lub·bā·šîm būṣ bim·ṣil·ta·yim ū·ḇin·ḇā·lîm wə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ‘ō·mə·ḏîm miz·rāḥ lam·miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘im·mā·hem kō·hă·nîm lə·mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm maḥ·ṣə·ri·rīm ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: all the Levitical singers Asaph Heman Jeduthun and their sons and relatives stood on the east side of the altar dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals harps and lyres accompanied by 120 . . . priests sounding trumpets
verses.literalPt: também os levitas, que eram cantores, todos eles, isto é, Asafe, Hemã, Jedutum e seus filhos, e irmãos, vestidos de linho fino e com címbalos, alaúdes e harpas, estavam em pé ao lado oriental do altar, e juntamente com eles cento e vinte sacerdotes que tocavam trombetas),

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְ֠אֶחָד לַמַּחֲצֹצְרִים וְלַמְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֜ים לְהַשְׁמִ֣יעַ קוֹל־ אֶחָ֗ד לְהַלֵּ֣ל וּלְהֹדוֹת֮ לַיהוָה֒ וּכְהָרִ֣ים ק֠וֹל בַּחֲצֹצְר֨וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֜יִם וּבִכְלֵ֣י הַשִּׁ֗יר וּבְהַלֵּ֤ל לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְהַבַּ֛יִת מָלֵ֥א עָנָ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵə·’e·ḥāḏ lam·ma·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rīm wə·lam·šō·ră·rîm lə·haš·mî·a‘ qō·wl- ’e·ḥāḏ lə·hal·lêl ū·lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh ū·ḵə·hā·rîm qō·wl ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ū·ḇim·ṣil·ta·yim ū·ḇiḵ·lê haš·šîr ū·ḇə·hal·lêl Yah·weh kî ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw wə·hab·ba·yiṯ mā·lê ‘ā·nān bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The trumpeters and singers . . . joined together to praise and thank the LORD with one voice They lifted up their voices accompanied by trumpets cymbals and musical instruments in praise to the LORD For He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever . . . And the temple the house of the LORD was filled with a cloud
verses.literalPt: quando os que tocavam trombetas e os que cantavam estavam acordes em fazerem ouvir uma só voz, dando graças a Jeová e louvando-o e quando levantavam a voz com as trombetas, címbalos e instrumentos de música e louvavam a Jeová, dizendo: Porque ele é bom, porque a sua misericórdia dura para sempre, então, se encheu duma nuvem a casa, a saber, a Casa de Jeová,

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָֽכְל֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים לַעֲמ֥וֹד לְשָׁרֵ֖ת מִפְּנֵ֣י הֶעָנָ֑ן כִּֽי־ מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm la·‘ă·mō·wḏ lə·šā·rêṯ mip·pə·nê he·‘ā·nān kî- mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud For the glory of the LORD filled the house of God
verses.literalPt: de modo que os sacerdotes não podiam ter-se em pé para ministrar por causa da nuvem, pois a glória de Jeová encheu a Casa de Deus.
